name: plugin.self_evaluating_pipeline
description: 3-layer LLM quality evaluation, golden regressions, and paired t-test statistical significance release gating (Otine 2026)
author: Brain Harness

entrypoints.name: evaluate_layer1
entrypoints.description: Sub-millisecond zero-cost deterministic guardrails (schema, bounds, URLs, refusals, AST)

entrypoints.name: evaluate_layer2_judge
entrypoints.description: Semantic LLM-as-judge evaluation with anchored 1-to-5 rubric and median consensus

entrypoints.name: calculate_cohens_kappa
entrypoints.description: Calculate Cohen's Kappa inter-annotator agreement corrected for chance

entrypoints.name: evaluate_statistical_significance_gate
entrypoints.description: Paired Student's t-test release gate (p < 0.05 AND mean diff > 0)
